rules: Submit only the 15 P0 Tier-A canonical routes materially changed by GO5 and allowed by the existing IndexNow policy gate.

The five P1 Tier-A routes changed in GO5 remain discoverable through their canonical HTML, internal links and evidence-backed sitemap lastmod; do not weaken the P0-only IndexNow guardrail to submit them.
Do not submit the full sitemap or unchanged category/editorial URLs.
The workflow must wait for the exact merge SHA to be the active production build before submission.
IndexNow acceptance is not a crawl, index, ranking or traffic guarantee.
Google indexing continues through normal crawl signals, canonicals, sitemap and Search Console when live connector data is available.
